transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, when I have to sit and focus on these long claim files at work, my mind just checks out and I end up putting them off or staring at the screen instead of getting them done. It's really starting to cause problems for me, and I just can't seem to push through it anymore.
Do you find that you struggle to stay focused on tasks even when you are feeling motivated and not particularly worried or down?

Yes, absolutely. Even when I'm highly motivated and working extra hours to catch up, I still hit this massive mental wall when trying to focus. My mind just drifts off anyway, and I get easily distracted by minor background noises in the office no matter how hard I try.
Did you experience these same difficulties with staying focused or being easily distracted when you were in elementary school, long before your current work stress?

Yes, this actually goes all the way back to when I was a kid. Even in elementary school, my teachers would write on my report cards that I daydreamed in class, forgot to turn in completed homework, and constantly lost worksheets or permission slips before they ever made it home.
